patterns.note: Full-width dark sections with content centered and constrained, often featuring a subtle background texture or gradient to differentiate areas.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings use a mix of white and a vibrant accent color for emphasis on key terms, creating a dynamic visual hierarchy.
A deep, dark background (near black) serves as the primary canvas, contrasted with bright white text and a striking teal/green accent for interactive elements, highlights, and key information.
Sections and individual content blocks reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, creating a progressive disclosure of content.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, transforming slightly (e.g., changing button visibility or adding a subtle shadow) after the initial scroll past the hero section.
A distinctive interactive 'playground' section allows users to immediately experiment with the core product functionality (voice AI) directly on the homepage, serving as a live demo.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark theme with high contrast, using a deep charcoal or black background paired with crisp white text and a vibrant, almost neon, teal/green for calls to action, highlighted keywords, and interactive states.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to progressively reveal content sections and individual elements. As the user scrolls down, new blocks of content appear to fade in and slide up smoothly from the bottom, creating a dynamic and engaging viewing experience. This is likely managed by a scroll-animation library like locomotive-scroll for smooth scrolling and element reveals.

The global navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport. Upon initial scroll, it subtly adjusts its appearance, such as gaining a background or shadow, to maintain visibility and distinction against the page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (up to ~3-4x body text) with a clear hierarchy, often using a vibrant accent color for key words, complemented by smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (small border-radius) is consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card-like elements, giving a soft, modern feel without being overtly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, transitioning to a more balanced density in feature grids and card layouts.

standout: The site's standout feature is its immediate integration of an interactive 'playground' directly on the homepage, allowing users to experience the core product (voice AI) without leaving the page. This, combined with the bold, high-contrast dark theme and vibrant accent colors, creates a highly engaging and product-centric first impression that feels both cutting-edge and user-friendly.
